parameters.name: ApplicationIds
parameters.description: The collection of uninstall application IDs.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: Department
parameters.description: The department to which the user belongs. The value is 1 to 128 characters in length, supports Chinese and uppercase and lowercase letters, and can contain digits, periods (.), commas (,), semicolons (;), hyphens (-), underscores (_), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), and spaces.

parameters.name: Hostname
parameters.description: The name of the terminal device. The value is 1 to 128 characters in length, supports Chinese and uppercase and lowercase letters, and can contain digits, periods (.), commas (,), semicolons (;), hyphens (-), underscores (\_), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), and spaces. Entering only an underscore (\_) additionally queries all terminal devices whose names contain 4-byte UTF-8 characters.

parameters.name: Mac
parameters.description: The MAC address of the terminal device.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 500.

parameters.name: Statuses
parameters.description: The collection of uninstall application statuses.

parameters.name: Username
parameters.description: The username. The value is 1 to 128 characters in length, supports Chinese and uppercase and lowercase letters, and can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), hyphens (-), asterisks (*), at signs (@), and spaces.
